4	root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
5	src = (root / "www" / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
6	out = root / "src" / "webide_www.c"
7	
8	def c_escape(s: str) -> str:
9	    parts = []
10	    for ch in s:
11	        o = ord(ch)
12	        if ch == "\\":
13	            parts.append("\\\\")
14	        elif ch == '"':
15	            parts.append('\\"')
16	        elif ch == "\n":
17	            parts.append("\\n")
18	        elif ch == "\r":
19	            parts.append("\\r")
20	        elif ch == "\t":
21	            parts.append("\\t")
22	        elif o < 32:
23	            parts.append("\\%03o" % o)
24	        else:
25	            parts.append(ch)
26	    return "".join(parts)
27	
28	lines = [
29	    "/****************************************************************************",
30	    " * vendor/webide/src/webide_www.c  (generated from www/index.html)",
31	    " ****************************************************************************/",
32	    "",
33	    "const char g_webide_index_html[] =",
34	]
35	chunk = 80
36	for i in range(0, len(src), chunk):
37	    lines.append('  "%s"' % c_escape(src[i:i + chunk]))
38	lines.append(";")
39	lines.append("const unsigned int g_webide_index_html_len = %d;" % len(src.encode("utf-8")))
40	lines.append("")
41	out.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
42	print("wrote", out, "chars", len(src))
